mqtt_settings.title: MQTT connection
mqtt_settings.description: Leave the host empty to use Home Assistant MQTT. Password blank keeps the saved password. Application write receipts must be supported by the endpoint. Leave them disabled for ordinary brokers.

data_description.allow_eeprom_writes: On by default. 3 commands per hour and 5 commands per day per stove, shared by cloud, Bluetooth and local MQTT. Cloud and Bluetooth give the count back when the write fails. MQTT gives it back only when the command was not sent. Turn off to block these writes from this integration.
